meta.title: 老板眼里「好工作」的五条标准
meta.title_en: Five Criteria for a Good Job in Your Boss's Eyes

scenes.title_cn: 为什么我拼命工作却不被重视
scenes.title_en: Why my hard work goes unnoticed
scenes.context: 讲者描述职场中「埋头加班」的心态，反问你对「做得好」的标准从哪来。
sentences: 你对你自己工作做得好的认知怎么来的呢？
Where does your own definition of doing well at work come from?
认知怎么来的：where does your definition come from
是只要我在公司吭哧吭哧干，就是干得好吗？
Is it simply that if I keep grinding away at the office, I'm doing well?
吭哧吭哧干：grind away
我们对好的标准是这样评价的吗？
Is that really how we judge what is good?
评价标准：how we judge
paraphrase: 埋头干活 = 干得好？→ 重新审视
Grinding away doesn't equal doing well — rethink your standard.
你怎么定义「做得好」→ 追问自己
Ask yourself where your own standard of 'good' comes from.
scenes.speak: Where does your own definition of doing well at work come from? Is it simply that if I keep grinding away at the office, I'm doing well? Is that really how we judge what is good?

scenes.title_cn: 管理者眼里的五条好标准
scenes.title_en: The five standards a manager values
scenes.context: 讲者给出老板评价「好」的五条标准，并对比「同事有重点有汇报」。
sentences: 第一，你要识别事情的重要性和优先级。
First, you identify what matters most and set priorities.
优先级：priorities
执行过程中，要提前预警风险。
During execution, flag risks early.
提前预警：flag risks early
除了主计划，你应该有 Plan B 的计划。
Besides the main plan, you should have a Plan B.
主计划之外：besides the main plan
paraphrase: 识别优先级→ 分清轻重缓急
Sort tasks by importance before acting.
Always have a backup plan when things change.
scenes.speak: First, you identify what matters most and set priorities. During execution, flag risks early. Besides the main plan, you should have a Plan B.

scenes.context: 讲者对比同事的做法——有重点、有过程、有汇报，给老板安全感。
sentences: 人家有重点、有过程、有汇报，让老板有安全感。
He is focused, process-driven, and communicative, which gives the boss a sense of security.
安全感：a sense of security
所以他不受重视，是因为你自己能力不行。
So if you're overlooked, it's because your own capability falls short.
被忽视：be overlooked
从你那个井口里走出来，看看世界吧。
Step out of your own well and take a look at the world.
井口：well / narrow perspective
paraphrase: 有重点有过程有汇报 → 让老板安心
Being focused and communicative reassures the boss.
从井口走出来 → 打开视野
Step out of your narrow view and see the bigger picture.
scenes.speak: He is focused, process-driven, and communicative, which gives the boss a sense of security. So if you're overlooked, it's because your own capability falls short. Step out of your own well and take a look at the world.

practice: 描述「识别优先级」这件事
Identify what matters most and tackle it first.
Flag potential risks to your boss early on.
I always keep a Plan B in case things change.
My updates give the boss a sense of security.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Do good work is hard work.
✓ 地道说法：Doing well isn't just about working hard.
用动名词做主语，避免中式从句堆叠。
✓ 地道说法：Give the boss a sense of security.
give + a sense of + 情感名词更自然。
✕ 直译腔：From your well mouth walk out.
✓ 地道说法：Step out of your own well.
step out of 是固定搭配，比 walk out 更地道。
✓ 地道说法：Your capability falls short.
用 fall short 表达「能力不足」更地道。
shifts: 把加班当作工作能力的证明
把「有结果 + 过程透明」当作证明
把汇报当作给老板安全感的职责
把「老板偏心」当作不受重视的原因
先对照五条标准审视自己的表现
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（如「底层杯」按上下文校正为「备份」）。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
